Follow the ten assignments in order. Use every selected sense at least once. There must be at least two distinct slang terms; when ten terms are supplied use all ten. The difficulty distribution is exactly 5 easy, 3 medium, 2 hard. These are nominal writing-design labels only.

Each question has this complete shape (values here describe the schema, not additional reference data):
{
  "id":"<questionId from its assignment>",
  "senseId":"<assigned senseId>",
  "slang":"<exact reference term>",
  "targetMeaning":"<exact reference targetMeaning>",
  "difficulty":"easy|medium|hard",
  "contextId":"<nonempty scenario identifier>",
  "contextCategory":"personal|education|work|prediction|sports|entertainment|opinion|friends|event-reaction",
  "post":{
    "displayName":"Fictional Display Name",
    "handle":"@fictional_author",
    "hashtag":"#FictionalMoment",
    "content":"A natural short post that contains the exact slang term verbatim and uses it in the assigned sense.",
    "comments":[{"handle":"@fictional_reply","text":"An indirect reaction, not a definition.","avatarId":"guest_02"}],
    "avatarId":"guest_01"
  },
  "questionComment":"Wait, what does <exact slang term> mean here?",
  "question":"What does '<exact slang term>' mean in this post?",
  "options":["plausible wrong meaning","<exact reference targetMeaning>","different plausible wrong meaning","another plausible wrong meaning"],
  "correctIndex":1,
  "explanation":"A brief explanation connecting the situation to the reference meaning."
}

Writing requirements:
- Choose each scenario to fit that particular term and sense naturally. Vary situations, voices, reactions and narrative angles. Do not force terms into unsuitable situations to fill a category quota.
- post.content MUST contain the exact reference term verbatim, used in the assigned sense. Never replace the term with its definition, a paraphrase, a synonym, or a description of it; the literal term must appear in the post text itself. The normalized definition belongs only in targetMeaning and explanation.
- contextCategory MUST be exactly one of: personal, education, work, prediction, sports, entertainment, opinion, friends, event-reaction. Repeating categories and contextId values is allowed; ten unique categories are neither possible nor required.
- Easy posts give clear situational clues; medium posts require a little inference; hard posts use subtler social implications, not missing information or ambiguous keys.
- Four distinct, similarly concise options: exactly one is the targetMeaning VERBATIM. correctIndex is its zero-based index. Vary correct positions. Distractors should reflect varied, plausible misunderstandings grounded in each post, not repeated stock distractors or trivially absurd meanings. Never create a second defensible correct option.
- Add 2 or 3 short fictional ordinary replies. Replies react indirectly through context, implications, or jokes; they never define the term, copy any complete option, identify an answer letter/index, or disclose the explanation.
- questionComment is a separate natural in-thread question, 10–220 characters, ending with a question mark. It MUST contain the exact slang term verbatim, in addition to its presence in post.content. Never replace the term with a pronoun, a description, the real-world referent, or the meaning. Vary its phrasing. Use a literal misunderstanding only if natural for this term; otherwise ask a contextual clarification. It must not contain any complete option, targetMeaning, answer letter/index, or explanation.
- Do not spell out the answer in the post itself or encode it in an identity, hashtag, scenario ID, or avatar. The explanation is the only place for teaching after the answer.
- Use unique question IDs exactly as assigned. No URLs, image paths, SVG, base64, real personal/contact information, brands, harassment, hate, slurs, sexual content, violence, or self-harm. All actors and events are fictional.

Local illustrated profile pictures are available by avatarId only.
Allowed avatarId values: mira, campus, ari, matchday, ben, lila, dea, jo, townloop, naya, sam, kai, guest_01, guest_02, guest_03, guest_04, guest_05, guest_06, guest_07, guest_08, player, default.
Add avatarId to post and each post.comments entry. Use the same avatarId every time a handle appears in the package.
For established characters use these mappings: @miramoments=mira, @campusfeed=campus, @ariatwork=ari, @matchdaychat=matchday, @benchside=ben, @lilalistens=lila, @deasays=dea, @justjo=jo, @townloop=townloop, @naya=naya, @sam=sam, @confuseduser=kai.
For new fictional handles prefer guest_01 through guest_08. Do not use player for a bot.
Never return an image URL, SVG, file path or base64 image. The Android app resolves IDs to bundled pictures offline.
Avatars express a stable fictional identity only; do not encode difficulty, answer correctness, target meaning or grading in avatar choices.

Output only the JSON object. Do not repeat the input data or include references in the output.
